title: Common Verbs
description: Learn the most frequently used Hindi verbs — eat, drink, go, come, see, and understand.

exercises.explanation: The four most essential Hindi verbs — infinitive forms ending in '-na'.

exercises.question: What does 'dekhna' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Dekhna' = to see or to look. 'Dekho!' = look! 'Main dekh raha hoon' = I'm looking.
'Main ja raha hoon' = I'm going (present progressive, masculine). Woman says 'ja rahi hoon'.
exercises.hint: sounds like: main jaa ruh-haa hoon

exercises.sentence: Main ___ chahta hoon. (I want to eat.)
exercises.explanation: 'Main khaana chahta hoon' = I want to eat. Khaana + chahna = want to eat.
'Yahaan aao' = come here (informal). Polite: 'yahaan aaiye'. 'Idhar aao' is also common.

exercises.question: What does 'samajhna' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Samajhna' = to understand. 'Samajh gaya?' = did you understand? 'Samajh gaya' = I understood.
'Khaane chalte hain' = let's go eat. Khaane = to eat (oblique), chalte hain = let's go.
'Bolna' = to speak or to say. 'Dhire boliye' = please speak slowly. 'Kya bola?' = what did (he/she) say?
